title: Pulsar Rok Wax eRig Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
Introducing the Pulsar Rok Wax eRig Vaporizer – the pinnacle of portable dab rig technology, designed for those who appreciate the finer nuances of dabbing. This electric dab rig is a game-changer in the world of wax vaporizers, offering an unmatched combination of style and functionality. Standing at a compact 6.75 inches, the Pulsar Rok boasts an isolated airpath and three adjustable voltage settings, allowing you to tailor your vaping experience to your preferences. The 30-second ‘RöK Mode’ elevates your sessions, ensuring you get the most out of your concentrates.

Crafted with an all-metal body, the Pulsar Rok is not only sleek but also durable. It features coilless quartz and ceramic cups, which work together to extract the full flavour profile of your wax. The Boro glass filtration base and disc percolator provide smooth, clean hits every time. Plus, the included carb cap ensures efficient vaporization.

Your purchase includes essential accessories: a dabber tool, wire brushes, a wax carb cap, both quartz and ceramic cups, silicone collars, a USB charging cable, Crud Bud alcohol-filled cotton buds, and more. This ensures you have everything you need for a seamless experience.

The Pulsar Rok stands out for its superior quality and performance. With its one-year limited warranty, the Pulsar Rok is not only an investment in your dabbing journey but also a commitment to quality. Experience the best electric dab rigs have to offer with the Pulsar Rok – where innovation, functionality, and higher culture meet.
